_note: Candidate registry for Vermont 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 2026 General Election Candidate Listing/Financial Disclosure (qualified candidates, last updated 9/23/2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 2026 General Election Candidate Listing/Financial Disclosure (qualified candidates, last updated 9/23/2026) (https://outside.vermont.gov/dept/sos/Elections_Division/election_info_resources/candidates/2026_general_election_qualified_candidates.xlsx); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
